issues.description: Method Farm.addAnimal: the UML in problem_statement.md declares addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean (returns boolean), while the reference implementation defines public void addAnimal(Animal animal) (void return) in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java. This inconsistency between the UML and the code (and the template/Main usage) can confuse students about the expected signature and may lead them to implement the wrong return type or encounter mismatches with tests and example code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of addAnimal consistent across artifacts. Recommended: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare addAnimal(animal: Animal): void to match the template, Main usage, and solution implementation. Alternatively, if a boolean return is desired, change the template and solution implementation to return boolean (for example return true after successful add) and update Main/tests and textual descriptions accordingly.
